summary: Shell installers, hooks, operational scripts, evals and Nix payloads accept preferred FRACTAL_* environment names while retaining legacy ST_*, ST3_* and SMALLTALK_* aliases

replay.detail: No graph replay; environment selection changes only at process boundaries.

compatibility.detail: arn:lmig:smalltalk:2026-10-16-env-fractal-dual-read: preferred names win even when explicitly empty; conflicting nonempty preferred identities and present differing legacy aliases fail closed with variable names only. Shell writers and clearers update both aliases.

manual.detail: Existing legacy environment settings remain readable.

recovery.detail: Restore matching identity aliases or clear both conflicting aliases before retrying a hook.
